title: High Priest Maltan assault
summary: Face High Priest Maltan with five Plasmatic attendants.
overview: At the relevant cleric pre-epic stage, give Gavon the talisman to start the assault. It summons Maltan, two priests and three priestesses together, then removes Gavon.
The talisman is returned and the cleric quest advances. At the following stage, hailing Gavon can start the same encounter again.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Prepare to control six enemies at the spawn point.

sections.title: Quest requirement
paragraphs: This trigger is restricted to clerics with the matching recorded quest stage.

notes: Approved row E130. Quest source reviewed; live encounter behavior and loaded database spell/loot data have not been verified.
